## Modules

- [TimelessTraces](https://timeless-traces.hexdocs.pm/TimelessTraces.md): Embedded OpenTelemetry span storage and compression for Elixir applications.
- [TimelessTraces.DB](https://timeless-traces.hexdocs.pm/TimelessTraces.DB.md): SQLite connection manager with a single writer and pooled readers.
- [TimelessTraces.Exporter](https://timeless-traces.hexdocs.pm/TimelessTraces.Exporter.md): OpenTelemetry traces exporter that stores spans in TimelessTraces.
- [TimelessTraces.HTTP](https://timeless-traces.hexdocs.pm/TimelessTraces.HTTP.md): Optional HTTP interface compatible with VictoriaTraces (OTLP ingest) and Jaeger (query).
- [TimelessTraces.Result](https://timeless-traces.hexdocs.pm/TimelessTraces.Result.md): Query result with pagination metadata.

- [TimelessTraces.Span](https://timeless-traces.hexdocs.pm/TimelessTraces.Span.md): A single OpenTelemetry span.

- [TimelessTraces.Stats](https://timeless-traces.hexdocs.pm/TimelessTraces.Stats.md): Aggregate statistics about stored span data.

- [TimelessTraces.Telemetry](https://timeless-traces.hexdocs.pm/TimelessTraces.Telemetry.md): Telemetry events emitted by TimelessTraces.

## Mix Tasks

- [mix timeless_traces.compression_benchmark](https://timeless-traces.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.TimelessTraces.CompressionBenchmark.md): Benchmark zstd vs openzl columnar compression for span blocks
- [mix timeless_traces.http_benchmark](https://timeless-traces.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.TimelessTraces.HttpBenchmark.md): Benchmark HTTP ingest and query throughput via Rocket
- [mix timeless_traces.index_benchmark](https://timeless-traces.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.TimelessTraces.IndexBenchmark.md): Benchmark pure ETS index operations in isolation (no disk I/O)
- [mix timeless_traces.ingest_benchmark](https://timeless-traces.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.TimelessTraces.IngestBenchmark.md): Benchmark ingestion throughput through the full pipeline
- [mix timeless_traces.search_benchmark](https://timeless-traces.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.TimelessTraces.SearchBenchmark.md): Benchmark query throughput across different filter patterns
